summary_1line: Vishnu battles the Rakshasa army, routs them with arrows and his conch, and ultimately slays the demon leader Mali with his discus.

image_candidates.scene_text: Surrounded by dark Rakshasas raining weapons like storm clouds, Vishnu stands radiant while drawing his bow amid the chaos.
Vishnu blows the conch Panchajanya, its thunderous sound shaking the three worlds as Rakshasa warriors fall from chariots and elephants stagger.
The blazing discus of Vishnu flies like a wheel of time and severs Mali’s head, which falls amid torrents of blood while the gods roar in triumph.
